Class RecordComposition

java.lang.Object
ca.mcscert.jpipe.commands.RegularCommand
ca.mcscert.jpipe.commands.linking.RecordComposition
All Implemented Interfaces:

public final class RecordComposition extends RegularCommand
Records on a composed model the operator call that built it; see JustificationModel.recordComposition(Composition).

    • RecordComposition

      public RecordComposition(String container, String operator, List<String> sourceNames, Map<String,String> arguments, Set<String> idArguments, Set<String> resultIdArguments)
      Parameters:
      container - the composed model.
      operator - the operator's name.
      sourceNames - the models composed, in call order.
      arguments - the call's arguments, element ids as the unit names them.
      idArguments - the keys of arguments whose value holds element ids.
      resultIdArguments - the keys of idArguments whose ids name an element of the result rather than of a source.
